zh.title: 摄影规划、多语言与反馈
zh.summary: 新增多日摄影规划与机位时段对比，支持 42 种语言，并提供反馈入口。

items.text: 多日总览：在「天文」中比较未来 7 天的拍摄窗口与天气，或查看 30 天天文日历，快速选择拍摄日期。
机位时段对比：收藏机位支持按整天、无月、银河、日落前后或自选时段比较天气，目前限同一时区。
反馈与建议：在「关于」中提交问题或功能建议，可附截图。
多语言：支持 42 种语言，可跟随 Windy 或单独设置；其他语言按需下载并缓存，减小插件体积。紧凑按钮与设置页采用简短文案，窄屏导航和语言框以省略号显示长名称，避免拆词撑高。新增翻译尚未全部经母语者审校。

en.title: Photography planning, languages and feedback
en.summary: Plan shoots across days, compare time windows at favorite sites, choose from 42 languages and share feedback.

items.text: Multi-day overview: compare shooting windows and weather over seven days in Astro, or browse a 30-day astronomy calendar to choose a shooting date.
Site comparisons: compare favorite sites over whole days, moonless, Milky Way, sunset or custom windows. Currently limited to sites in one time zone.
Feedback: report issues or suggest features from About, with optional screenshots.

Languages: choose from 42 languages, follow Windy or set your own. Other languages download individually and are cached to reduce plugin size. Compact controls and Settings use shorter labels, while narrow navigation and language selectors show ellipses for long names instead of splitting words across lines. New translations have not all been reviewed by native speakers.
